project_context.domain: Personal Portfolio - Senior AI Engineer / AI Architect

surfaces_and_effects.cards: rounded-none or minimal rounded-lg. Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10). Flat dark background. Soft inner glow on hover.
surfaces_and_effects.glassmorphism: Used only for Sticky Header. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5
surfaces_and_effects.tracing_beam: Used for Case Studies or Highlight cards. Glowing sky-blue subtle border effect on hover.
surfaces_and_effects.mesh_gradient: Subtle, dark, grainy gradient in the background to avoid flat black.
surfaces_and_effects.particles: TSParticles implementation in the Hero section to simulate neural networks. Extremely subtle, low opacity, silver/sky-blue lines.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-medium hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/40 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors px-6 py-3
buttons.accent: bg-sky-500 text-white font-medium hover:bg-sky-400 transition-colors px-6 py-3

skill_chips.style: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-mono text-zinc-300 rounded hover:border-sky-500/50 hover:bg-sky-500/10 transition-colors

timeline.style: Vertical line using border-l border-white/10. Nodes should be small squares or icons with bg-black border border-white/20. Content should have generous left padding.

contact_form.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 pb-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-sky-500 text-white w-full rounded-none px-0 text-lg transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-600

interactions_and_animations.scrolling: Use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling to give momentum.
interactions_and_animations.reveals: Framer Motion for staggered fade-up on scroll (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6).
interactions_and_animations.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with border brightening. Buttons change background cleanly without jumping.
interactions_and_animations.hero_animation: Neural network particles drifting slowly. Text staggers in gracefully.

page_sections.content: Name, Title, Location, Tagline, CTAs. 'Open to roles' badge.
page_sections.design_notes: Full viewport height. Background is `hero_bg_particles` image or TSParticles + mesh gradient. Bold Cabinet Grotesk H1. Generous negative space.

page_sections.content: Concise bio + 4 highlight cards (9+ Yrs Exp, GenAI/Agentic, RAG/LLM/Speech, MLOps).
page_sections.design_notes: Bento grid layout for the 4 highlight cards. High contrast numbers.
Grid layout. Use Lucide icons (CircuitBoard, Brain, Database, etc.) in a muted accent color. Minimalist borders.

page_sections.content: Highlight: Presight AI Senior AI Engineer.
page_sections.design_notes: Full-width feature banner. Deep slate background with sky-blue glowing edge (Tracing Beam effect).
Use Lucide icons (Building, Briefcase) as logo placeholders for companies. Clean typography, muted dates.
Asymmetrical layout or horizontal scroll. High focus on data/results.
Categories as overlines (font-mono, uppercase). Chips flow in flex wrap.
Massive footer area. Minimalist form (just lines, no heavy boxes). Large typography.

media.company_logos_strategy: Use purely lucide-react icons like Building2, Network, BrainCircuit, Cpu, Database for company placeholders to maintain the minimalist dark aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors provided.
Implement the 'Open to roles' badge as a pulsing/glowing small pill in the hero section.
Use framer-motion for all staggered reveals and hover effects. Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements.
Use `react-tsparticles` for the neural network effect in the Hero, overlaid on the `gradient_mesh_bg` or solid #050505.
Use standard HTML inputs customized via Tailwind for the contact form, storing data into MongoDB.
Ensure `lucide-react` is used extensively for minimalist icons across expertise, timeline, and tech skills.
Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the dark background.
